description.value: Red Fish Blue Fish is a beloved seafood shack built into an upcycled shipping container perched on a wooden pier in Victoria's Inner Harbour, serving sustainable Ocean Wise-certified fish and chips, tacones, and grilled seafood since 2007. It has earned features in Lonely Planet, the Today Show, and Food Network Canada's Eat Street, making it a genuine Victoria institution. Outdoor seating on the pier puts diners front-row to seaplanes, boats, and the occasional seal passing through the busy inner harbour.
